message.content:
Based on my search, here is a comprehensive list of Sherlock Holmes movies organized by era and series:

## Silent Films (1900–1929)
- *Sherlock Holmes Baffled* (1900)
- *Adventures of Sherlock Holmes; or, Held for Ransom* (1905)
- *Sherlock Holmes in the Great Murder Mystery* (1908)
- *Arsène Lupin contra Sherlock Holmes* (1910)
- *The Speckled Band* (1912)
- *Silver Blaze* (1912)
- *A Study in Scarlet* (1914)
- *Der Hund von Baskerville* (1914)
- *The Valley of Fear* (1916)
- *Sherlock Holmes* (1916)
- *Sherlock Holmes* (1922) — John Barrymore
- *The Hound of the Baskervilles* (1921)
- *The Sign of Four* (1923)
- *Der Hund von Baskerville* (1929)

## Éclair & Stoll Pictures Series (1912–1923)
Numerous short films including *The Beryl Coronet*, *The Musgrave Ritual*, *The Reigate Squires*, *The Copper Beeches*, *Charles Augustus Milverton*, *The Abbey Grange*, *The Norwood Builder*, *Silver Blaze*, *The Speckled Band*, and many more.

## 1931 British Film Series (Arthur Wontner)
- *The Sleeping Cardinal* (1931)
- *The Missing Rembrandt* (1932)
- *The Sign of Four: Sherlock Holmes' Greatest Case* (1932)
- *The Triumph of Sherlock Holmes* (1935)
- *Silver Blaze* (1937)

## Basil Rathbone Series (1939–1946)
- *The Hound of the Baskervilles* (1939)
- *The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes* (1939)
- *Sherlock Holmes and the Voice of Terror* (1942)
- *Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon* (1942)
- *Sherlock Holmes in Washington* (1943)
- *Sherlock Holmes Faces Death* (1943)
- *The Spider Woman* (1944)
- *The Scarlet Claw* (1944)
- *The Pearl of Death* (1944)
- *The House of Fear* (1945)
- *The Woman in Green* (1945)
- *Pursuit to Algiers* (1945)
- *Terror by Night* (1946)
- *Dressed to Kill* (1946)

## Other Notable Films (1959–2000s)
- *The Hound of the Baskervilles* (1959) — Peter Cushing
- *Sherlock Holmes and the Deadly Necklace* (1962)
- *A Study in Terror* (1965)
- *The Private Life of Sherlock Holmes* (1970)
- *The Seven-Per-Cent Solution* (1976)
- *Sherlock Holmes in New York* (1976) — Roger Moore
- *The Adventure of Sherlock Holmes' Smarter Brother* (1975)
- *Murder by Decree* (1979)
- *Young Sherlock Holmes* (1985)
- *The Great Mouse Detective* (1986)
- *Without a Clue* (1988) — Michael Caine
- *Hands of a Murderer* (1990)
- *Sherlock Holmes and the Leading Lady* (1991)
- *Incident at Victoria Falls* (1992)
- *The Hound of London* (1993)
- *1994 Baker Street: Sherlock Holmes Returns* (1993)
- *The Hound of the Baskervilles* (2000) — Matt Frewer
- *The Sign of Four* (2001)
- *The Royal Scandal* (2001)
- *The Case of the Whitechapel Vampire* (2002)
- *Sherlock Holmes and the Case of the Silk Stocking* (2004)

## Modern Era (2009–Present)
- *Sherlock Holmes* (2009) — Robert Downey Jr.
- *Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows* (2011)
- *Mr. Holmes* (2015) — Ian McKellen
- *Sherlock Gnomes* (2018)
- *Holmes and Watson* (2018)
- *Enola Holmes* (2020) — Henry Cavill as Sherlock
- *Enola Holmes 2* (2022)
- *Enola Holmes 3* (2026) — upcoming

## Upcoming Films (2025–2026)
- *Sherlock Holmes: Mare of the Night* (2025)
- *Detective Chinatown 1900* (2025)
- *Young Sherlock* (2026) — Hero Fiennes Tiffin, Prime Video
- *Enola Holmes 3* (2026) — Netflix
